## Triage: grade completed — `priority:p1` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue`. Ruling: the server's list filter folds the position spellings through `resolveActor`'s one rule. The filer's `bug` · `domain:services` stand Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-02T06:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. **Why p1.** Every position-routed approval is invisible in its approvers' "My Pending", and every one of HotCRM's approval flows routes to positions. It reproduces on 17.5.0 and 17.6.0. The approvals themselves still work, so it is not p0. **Ruling: the server fold** (triage's; overturnable by the maintainer). - The acting path (`resolveActor`) already treats `role:

` and `position:

` as one identity. The list filter (`approverRequestIds`) reads that same equivalence from **one shared normalizer**, extracted from `resolveActor`. ⛔ No second fold written beside it. - This covers every client, not only the console. - **objectui's docblock** (`sharedUserFeeds.ts`, which says "`role:` is the server's addressing scheme") is wrong about what the server stores. The claim files an objectui coordination child (category ④) to send `position:`, the stored spelling. It is not blocking: the fold makes either spelling work. **Pins:** a user staffed into the position sees the request in "My Pending" under either spelling. The acting path is unchanged (the control). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
